$comment: Single source of truth for the Asia Markets sector roster.
Consumed by scripts/sectors.mjs (which all three build scripts import) and
by tests/test_asia_markets_wiring.py. Adding a sector should require editing
this file and nothing else in the build pipeline.
live[]     - sectors with a published dashboard page.
code       display number on the hub sector index (not the array order).
id         slug; also fixes .generated/<id>-artifact.json and the route.
package    src/<package>/ pipeline that produces this sector's data.
builder    artifact builder, relative to this app root.
statusFile status JSON under src/data/, written by the builder.
planned[]  - research-only placeholders rendered as non-clickable rows.
evidence   research doc backing the claimed state; the wiring test asserts
it still exists, so deleting the doc fails CI instead of leaving
the hub claiming research that is no longer in the repo.
